name: ubc
notes: Three receivers share one rooftop at 49°15'57.7"N 123°15'06.5"W (UBC). Illuminators: CHAN-DT (DTV, ENE, the strongest in the search), CHEK-DT (DTV, S, the only DTV site outside Vancouver) and CISC-FM (FM, NW, the third direction no DTV site covers): about 110-140 deg apart around UBC. Beams aim at YVR (148 deg, 9.3 km) and are 120 deg wide, and YVR traffic is held within 40 km, so a three-aircraft scene stays in view about 97% of the time. Node ids start with synth- so the server treats them as simulated and shows them on the map.
